e2e.auth_notes: The actor is the seeded student 小明 (balance 80), whose credentials come from the sample .env only.

db.notes: Recharging 100 updates student 24's balance 80 -> 180. No transaction/ledger table exists in this schema — the balance column is the only fingerprint. expected_delta.json is captured from the pristine app (never hand-written). The schema has no volatile columns (no timestamps/counters): every seeded date is fixed in the dump and the flows fill any date input explicitly, so ignore_columns is empty. All six tables are listed so the capture tooling can warn about any change outside the spec. Shiro sessions live in memory, not in the DB — there is no session table to exclude.
